court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Sub-Court at Mettur, H.M.O.P.No.32 of 2019; Family Court at Chengalpattu, M.C.No.12 of 2022
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2005. They are living separately due to misunderstandings. Petitioner filed a maintenance case in the Family Court, while respondent filed for divorce in the Sub-Court.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance to minor children is a right to life as envisaged under Article 21 of the Constitution.
legal_principles.held: No children shall be deprived of the right to maintenance from the parents and even in the case where the unemployed wives maintaining the children, the fathers are not paying any maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: Courts dealing with maintenance petitions are expected to be sensitive in granting interim maintenance at the first instance.
legal_principles.held: Even in the deserving cases, in the absence of any application by the mother, who may some time be ignorant, has to grant interim maintenance suo motu which is permissible in view of the law laid out.

outcome.final_order: Transfer petition is allowed and H.M.O.P.No.32 of 2019 is withdrawn from the Sub-Court at Mettur and transferred to the Family Court at Chengalpattu to be tried along with M.C.No.12 of 2022.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of cases between courts
